'''Hyron Tremel''' was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] of the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and the ancestor of [[Tremel]]. Hyron Tremel was known for applying brutal training exercises on [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith students]], a practice which would be continued by Hyron's descendant.<ref name="TOR-Encyclopedia" />
